tracking.label: All-in-One Tracking
tracking.title: Everything your baby needs,
tracking.description: 12 record types designed by parents, for parents. Log feeds, sleep, diapers, growth, and more in seconds — not minutes.

insights.label: Insights
insights.title: See the
insights.description: Six-dimension analysis across weight, height, head circumference, feeding, sleep, and diapers. Spot trends, catch anomalies, and share professional reports with your pediatrician.

predictions.label: Smart Predictions
predictions.title: Know when,
predictions.description: Bebilog learns your baby's rhythm and predicts the next feed and sleep window. No more guessing — just timely notifications when it's time.

growth.label: Growth Charts
growth.title: Medical-grade
growth.description: WHO standard growth charts with z-score references. Born early? INTERGROWTH-21st preterm charts activate automatically with corrected age display.

vaccine.label: Vaccine Schedule
vaccine.title: Never miss
vaccine.description: Smart scheduling for China (NIP), US (CDC), Japan, and Europe. Tracks doses, minimum intervals, and live-vaccine rules automatically.

food.label: Baby Food Hub
food.title: Introduce food
food.description: AI-powered 7-day meal plans by age stage. Track allergen introduction with clear status indicators and safety cooldown windows.
